title: Definition.
bodyText: "Governor-elect" means the person who is the apparent successful candidate for the office of governor, as ascertained by the chief election officer following the general election.
bodyHtml: [§30-2]  Definition.  "Governor-elect" means the person who is the apparent successful candidate for the office of governor, as ascertained by the chief election officer following the general election. [L 1972, c 126, pt of §1]
